claims: OSHA is a U.S. federal agency under the Department of Labor.
OSHA provides training on workplace safety standards.
OSHA requires employers to eliminate recognized hazards.
Employers must keep records of injuries.
Employers must report fatalities within 8 hours.
Employers must report hospitalizations within 24 hours.
Workers can access injury records without fear of retaliation.
OSHA can issue citations for violations.
OSHA can issue fines for violations.
OSHA can issue penalties for violations.
OSHA provides free consultations to improve safety programs.
